capabilities.name: Microphone
capabilities.requiredAccess: Record audio while you are speaking to ZARVIS.
capabilities.androidRequirements: A speech recognition service must be installed (SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable).
capabilities.dataExposure: Audio is converted to text by the device's speech service; the text is sent to the ZARVIS backend as your request.
supportedActions: Speech-to-text after you tap the microphone
capabilities.denialBehavior: Voice input is disabled; typing keeps working.
capabilities.revocationHandling: Checked every time listening starts; a revoked permission returns you to text input.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Apps > ZARVIS > Permissions > Microphone

rationale.why: To turn what you say into a request when you tap the microphone.
rationale.data: Your voice while listening is active. Nothing is recorded when the microphone is off.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS never listens in the background and has no wake word.
rationale.revoke: Turn off Microphone for ZARVIS in Android Settings at any time.

web.note: Browser speech recognition after you tap Speak, where the browser supports it (e.g. Chrome).

android.note: Android SpeechRecognizer after a tap. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Contacts
capabilities.requiredAccess: Read contact names and phone numbers stored on this phone.
capabilities.dataExposure: The matching contact's name and number are read on the device and shown to you. They are not uploaded.
supportedActions: Find a contact's number by name
Resolve a name before a call you confirm
capabilities.denialBehavior: Name lookups stop; calling a raw phone number still works with Phone permission.
capabilities.fallback: Say or type the phone number instead of a name.
capabilities.revocationHandling: Checked before every lookup; a revoked permission returns PERMISSION_REQUIRED.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Apps > ZARVIS > Permissions > Contacts

rationale.why: To find the number of a person you name, for example "find Mom's number".
rationale.data: Contact names and phone numbers, read on your phone only for the name you asked about.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS does not upload, share or change your contacts.
rationale.revoke: Turn off Contacts for ZARVIS in Android Settings at any time.

web.note: Browsers cannot read your phone's contacts. Use the Android app.

android.note: Name lookup via ContactsContract. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Phone calls
capabilities.requiredAccess: Place a phone call from this phone.
capabilities.androidRequirements: Telephony hardware and a dialer that handles ACTION_CALL.
capabilities.dataExposure: The number you confirm is passed to the phone's dialer. Call charges may apply.
supportedActions: Call a number or a named contact after you confirm the exact number
capabilities.denialBehavior: No call is placed. ZARVIS can show the number so you can dial it yourself.
capabilities.revocationHandling: Checked immediately before the call; a revoked permission returns PERMISSION_REQUIRED.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Apps > ZARVIS > Permissions > Phone

rationale.why: To place a call you ask for, after you confirm who and which number.
rationale.notAutomatic: Phone permission never lets ZARVIS call anyone without a separate confirmation for that exact call.
rationale.revoke: Turn off Phone for ZARVIS in Android Settings at any time.

web.note: Browsers cannot place phone calls. Use the Android app.

android.note: ACTION_CALL after a per-call confirmation showing the resolved number. Verification is limited to the dialer accepting the intent. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Notification access
capabilities.requiredAccess: Read notifications from other apps (Notification Listener).
capabilities.androidRequirements: A NotificationListenerService enabled by the user in system settings.
capabilities.dataExposure: Notification content from other apps, which can include messages and one-time codes.
unsupportedActions: Reading other apps' notifications (not implemented in this build)
capabilities.fallback: Open the app that sent the notification.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Notifications > Device & app notifications

rationale.notAutomatic: This build never reads other apps' notifications.
rationale.revoke: Nothing to revoke — the access is not requested.

web.note: Browsers cannot read other apps' notifications.

android.note: No notification listener exists in this build. Planned for Phase 12.

capabilities.name: Spoken notifications
capabilities.dataExposure: Notification content spoken through the speaker or headphones.
unsupportedActions: Speaking notifications (not implemented in this build)

rationale.notAutomatic: OTP, banking and authentication alerts will not be spoken by default.
rationale.revoke: Nothing to revoke — the feature is not active.

capabilities.name: Camera
capabilities.requiredAccess: Take a photo using the phone's camera app.
capabilities.androidRequirements: A camera app that handles ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE. ZARVIS does not declare the CAMERA permission.
capabilities.dataExposure: Only a small preview of the photo you take is returned to ZARVIS; it is shown to you and not uploaded or stored.
supportedActions: Take a photo with the system camera and show a preview
unsupportedActions: Taking photos without you pressing the shutter
Uploading or analyzing the photo (later phase)
capabilities.denialBehavior: If you cancel the camera, nothing is captured.
capabilities.revocationHandling: No runtime permission is held; each capture is a separate user action.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Not applicable — ZARVIS uses the system camera app.

rationale.why: To capture a photo when you ask.
rationale.data: The photo you take, as a preview.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS never opens the camera by itself and never takes a photo without you pressing the shutter.
rationale.revoke: There is no standing permission; just cancel the camera app.

web.note: Browser camera capture is not implemented.

android.note: System camera capture preview only; no storage or analysis. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Files
capabilities.requiredAccess: Open a document you choose with the system file picker.
capabilities.androidRequirements: Storage Access Framework (ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT). No storage permission.
capabilities.dataExposure: Only the file you pick. Its name, type and size are shown to you.
supportedActions: Pick one document and show its name, type and size
unsupportedActions: Reading files you did not pick
Uploading the file from Android (later phase)
capabilities.denialBehavior: If you cancel the picker, nothing is read.
capabilities.revocationHandling: Access is per-pick; nothing persists after the action.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Not applicable — the system picker grants one-time access.

rationale.why: To work with a document you choose.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS cannot see any other file, and picking a file does not upload it.
rationale.revoke: Nothing to revoke — access ends with the action.

web.note: Browser file picker; PDF/DOCX/text are extracted by the backend for the chat. Files are not stored.

android.note: System document picker; shows the chosen file's metadata only. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Photos
capabilities.requiredAccess: Choose a photo with the system photo picker.
capabilities.androidRequirements: Android Photo Picker (PickVisualMedia). No media permission.
supportedActions: Pick one photo and show its details
unsupportedActions: Reading photos you did not pick
capabilities.denialBehavior: If you cancel the picker, nothing is read.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Not applicable — the system picker grants one-time access.

rationale.why: To work with a photo you choose.
rationale.revoke: Nothing to revoke — access ends with the action.

web.note: Attach an image; it is analyzed by the backend's Gemini vision model when configured.

android.note: System photo picker; shows the chosen photo's metadata only. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Location
capabilities.requiredAccess: Your approximate (coarse) location when you ask for it.
capabilities.dataExposure: Approximate latitude/longitude, shown to you. Not uploaded or stored.
capabilities.fallback: Tell ZARVIS the place by name.
capabilities.revocationHandling: Checked before every read; a revoked permission returns PERMISSION_REQUIRED.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Apps > ZARVIS > Permissions > Location

rationale.why: To answer "where am I" style requests.
rationale.data: Your approximate location, only when you ask.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS never reads location in the background and never shares it.
rationale.revoke: Turn off Location for ZARVIS in Android Settings at any time.

android.note: Coarse location on request via LocationManager. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Bluetooth
capabilities.requiredAccess: Open Bluetooth settings so you can connect a device.
capabilities.androidRequirements: Settings.ACTION_BLUETOOTH_SETTINGS. No Bluetooth permission is declared.
capabilities.dataExposure: None — the system settings screen handles pairing.
unsupportedActions: Scanning, pairing or connecting devices automatically
Turning Bluetooth on or off silently
capabilities.fallback: Open Bluetooth from the quick settings panel.

rationale.why: To take you to Bluetooth settings when you ask.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS does not pair or connect devices for you.

android.note: System settings flow only (USER_ACTION_REQUIRED). Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Alarms & reminders
capabilities.requiredAccess: Post reminder notifications, and hand alarms to the Clock app.
capabilities.androidRequirements: POST_NOTIFICATIONS is a runtime permission only on Android 13+; on Android 8–12 notifications are controlled by the app's notification setting. Alarms use AlarmClock.ACTION_SET_ALARM (normal SET_ALARM permission).
capabilities.dataExposure: Reminder text is stored on this phone only.
supportedActions: Create a reminder at a time you state
Hand an alarm to the Clock app for you to save
unsupportedActions: Guessing a time you did not state
Deleting alarms in the Clock app
capabilities.denialBehavior: Reminders are not created, because they could not notify you.
capabilities.fallback: Set the alarm in the Clock app yourself.
capabilities.revocationHandling: Re-checked when the reminder fires; if notifications were turned off, nothing is shown.

rationale.why: To notify you at the time you set a reminder for.
rationale.data: The reminder text and time, stored on your phone.
rationale.notAutomatic: ZARVIS only notifies you about reminders you created.
rationale.revoke: Turn off notifications for ZARVIS in Android Settings at any time.

android.note: Reminders via AlarmManager + notification; alarms via the Clock app. Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Calendar
capabilities.requiredAccess: Open a pre-filled event in your calendar app for you to save.
capabilities.androidRequirements: A calendar app that handles Intent.ACTION_INSERT on CalendarContract.Events. No calendar permission is declared.
capabilities.dataExposure: The event title and time are passed to your calendar app.
supportedActions: Open a pre-filled new event for you to review and save
capabilities.fallback: Add the event in your calendar app yourself.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Not applicable — your calendar app saves the event.

rationale.why: To prepare an event you describe.
rationale.notAutomatic: The event is only saved if you tap Save in your calendar app.

web.note: Calendar integrations are planned for the Integrations Hub.

android.note: Pre-filled insert flow (USER_ACTION_REQUIRED). Implemented in code; not yet verified on a real device, so it is not marked WORKING.

capabilities.name: Accessibility service
capabilities.requiredAccess: An accessibility service that can read and act on the screen.
capabilities.androidRequirements: AccessibilityService enabled by the user; restricted by Google Play policy.

rationale.notAutomatic: Accessibility would never mean universal automation.

android.note: No accessibility service exists in this build.

capabilities.name: Usage access
capabilities.requiredAccess: See which apps you use and for how long.
capabilities.androidRequirements: PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS special access granted in system settings.
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Apps > Special app access > Usage access

android.note: Not implemented; the special access is not declared.

capabilities.name: Default assistant
capabilities.requiredAccess: Be selected as the phone's default digital assistant.
unsupportedActions: Acting as the default assistant (not implemented)
capabilities.settingsDestination: Android Settings > Apps > Default apps > Digital assistant app

android.note: No VoiceInteractionService exists in this build.

capabilities.name: Screen interaction
capabilities.requiredAccess: Read or interact with other apps' screens.
capabilities.androidRequirements: Accessibility or MediaProjection; both require explicit system consent.
unsupportedActions: Reading or tapping other apps' screens (not implemented)
